voice.prompt: Hey, what's a good quick lunch I can make in ten minutes?
voice.reply: You could whip up a quick quesadilla or a loaded avocado toast! A simple tuna salad sandwich is also a great option that takes no time at all. Do any of those sound good to you?

voice.prompt: Remind me why sleep matters so much for focus.
voice.reply: Sleep is essential because it allows your brain to process information and clear out toxins. It helps consolidate your memories and restores your mental energy for the next day. Without it, your concentration and cognitive functions will definitely take a hit!

voice.prompt: Tell me a short joke about computers.
voice.reply: Why did the computer go to the doctor? Because it had a virus!

voice.prompt: What's the difference between a latte and a cappuccino?
voice.reply: A cappuccino is smaller and has more foam, while a latte is larger and much milkier. Basically, a latte is much creamier, whereas a cappuccino is fluffier!

voice.prompt: I'm feeling a little unmotivated today. Any quick tip?
voice.reply: Try the five-minute rule: just commit to doing one small task for only five minutes. Often, the hardest part is just getting started! You've got this.

voice.prompt: How long should I boil an egg for a jammy yolk?
voice.reply: For a perfect jammy yolk, boil your eggs for about 6 to 7 minutes. Make sure to plunge them into an ice bath immediately after to stop the cooking!

voice.prompt: Give me one fun fact about octopuses.
voice.reply: Did you know that octopuses have three hearts? Two pump blood to the gills, while the third pumps it to the rest of the body!

voice.prompt: What's a good way to wind down before bed?
voice.reply: Try reading a physical book or listening to some calming music. It also helps to dim the lights and avoid screens for at least an hour before sleep. Sweet dreams!

voice.prompt: Should I go for a walk or a run if I only have twenty minutes?
voice.reply: If you want to get your heart rate up quickly, a run is your best bet! However, a brisk walk is also a great way to clear your head. Which one sounds more fun right now?

voice.prompt: Summarize what a credit score is in two sentences.
voice.reply: A credit score is a number that represents how reliably you manage your debts and repay loans. Lenders use this score to decide if they should lend you money and what interest rates to charge.
